etymology.hint: Simplified form of 戶; a door swinging on its hinge

characterDeckComponents.note: 户 (a simplified form of 戶) depicts a single door panel swinging on its hinge.

etymology.hint: Two men, one alive 土 and one dead 干; the living one is lucky

characterDeckComponents.note: The upper part, related to 土, traditionally depicted one person's fate.
干 depicted a contrasting fate — the character set two outcomes side by side, with the fortunate one giving 幸 its meaning 'lucky, fortunate.'

meanings: to send armed forces to suppress

makemeahanzi.definition: to haggle, to discuss; to demand, to ask for

etymology.hint: To ask 讠 for something 寸

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 讨 involves speaking, as in asking or discussing.
寸 (a hand/small measure) — combined with speech, suggests reaching out verbally to ask for something, giving 讨 its meaning 'to ask for, to discuss.'

meanings: (literary, or bound form) to look at

makemeahanzi.definition: to look at, to inspect, to observe, to regard

characterDeckComponents.note: 见 (to see) — relates directly to 视's meaning 'to look at, view.'
礻 (a form of 示, shì) gives the sound — 视 is also pronounced shì, an exact match.
页 (head/page) — 题 relates to the forehead or the topmost part, extending to the 'title' or 'topic' placed at the top.
是 (shì) gives a hint of the sound — 题 is pronounced tí, a connection that has shifted over time.
犭 (dog) — 猛 originally described a fierce dog, extending to 'fierce, violent' generally.
孟 (mèng) gives a sound close to měng, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to eliminate, to remove, to wipe out

etymology.hint: The waste 余 produced by a city 阝

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/settlement) — represents a city or town.
余 (surplus, remainder) — the leftover waste a city produces, which must be cleared away, giving 除 its meaning 'to remove, eliminate.'
雨 (rain) — 零 originally described light, scattered rain, extended to mean a fragment or zero.
令 (lìng) is an exact match for the sound of 零, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: bright, dazzling; to shake, to sway

characterDeckComponents.note: Sun — brightness relates to sunlight.
Gives the sound guāng, related to huǎng but drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Two hands 日, 又 pulling an eye open 罒

characterDeckComponents.note: 罒 (an eye) — held open.
又 (a hand) — pulling the eye open wide, together giving 曼 its meaning 'long, extended, graceful.'

meanings: to add color washes to a painting

makemeahanzi.definition: dye; to catch; to infect; to be contagious

etymology.hint: Water 氵 and wine 九 mixed in a wooden 木 bowl

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) pictures a wooden dyeing vat.
氿-shaped strokes above picture liquid dye poured into it, giving 染 its meaning 'to dye.'

meanings: to receive benefit or advantage through a contact

makemeahanzi.definition: to moisten, to soak, to wet; to touch

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 沾 describes getting wet or stained by a liquid.
占 (zhàn) gives a sound close to zhān, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.
衤 (clothes) — 裤 names a piece of clothing, trousers.
库 (kù) gives the sound — an exact match with 裤.
礻 (spirit/altar) — 福 relates to blessings granted by the spirits
畐 (fú) gives the sound — an exact match with 福's reading fú

makemeahanzi.definition: penalty, fine; to punish, to penalize

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 罰; to punish 刂 the accused 詈

characterDeckComponents.note: 罒 (a net) — historically linked to wrongdoing and being caught out.
刂 (a knife/blade) — carrying out punishment, together giving 罚 its meaning 'to punish, penalize.'

etymology.hint: A man 方 traveling with a pack 氏 on his back

characterDeckComponents.note: 方 here depicts a flag or banner, marking a group on the move.
氏 depicts a person following behind — together, a group traveling together, giving 旅 its meaning 'trip, journey.'
厂 (a building) — 厨 names a room in a building, the kitchen.
豆 (dòu) gives a sound distantly related to 厨's reading chú, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: One step 彳 coming behind another 夂; 幺 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 depicts a step or a road, related to walking.
夂 depicts a trailing, dragging foot — one step coming behind another, giving 後 its meaning 'behind, after.'

meanings: the 4th of the 10 Heavenly Stems 天干[tian1 gan1]
small cube of meat or vegetable

makemeahanzi.definition: male adult; robust, vigorous; 4th heavenly stem

characterDeckComponents.note: The character traces the head and shaft of a simple nail, a shape later borrowed for other meanings.

makemeahanzi.definition: bare, nude; to strip, to undress

characterDeckComponents.note: 衤 (clothes) — 裸 describes the absence of clothing, being bare.
果 (guǒ) gives a sound close to luǒ, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rip, to tear; to buy cloth

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 撕 describes a hand-related action, tearing something apart.
斯 (sī) gives the sound — an exact match with 撕.

meanings: classifier for events, cases, transactions, affairs etc

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 桩 originally named a wooden stake or post.
庄 (zhuāng) gives the sound — an exact match with 桩.

makemeahanzi.definition: to clutch, to grasp, to seize

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — catching something is done by hand.
Gives the sound zú, related to zhuō but drifted apart over time.
⺼ (flesh) — lungs are a body organ.
巿 (a rare character) gives a sound distantly related to fèi, having drifted apart over time.
阝 (a mound/enclosure) — relates to 院's meaning 'courtyard, institution,' an enclosed place.
完 (wán) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from yuàn.

etymology.hint: 厶 provides the meaning and pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — grain was one of the first things ancient people owned and kept for themselves.
厶 pictures something folded in on itself and hidden away, giving 私 its sense of 'private, personal, one's own.'

makemeahanzi.definition: nature's color; blue, green, black; young
bucket, pail, tub; can, cask, keg

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 桶 names an object often made of wood, a bucket.
甬 (yǒng) gives a sound only distantly related to tǒng today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to calculate, to count; to plan, to reckon; plot, scheme

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 计 relates to counting or planning through words and numbers.
十 (shí) gives a hint of the sound — 计 is pronounced jì, a connection that has shifted significantly over time.
酉 (wine) — 酱 (a fermented paste) is a wine-and-fermentation product.
丬 (qiáng) gives a sound distantly related to jiàng, sharing the same final but having drifted apart in initial consonant over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to take by force, to coerce; disaster; misfortune

characterDeckComponents.note: Strength — force is used to take something.
Gives the sound qù, related to jié but drifted apart over time.

meanings: classifier for scores in archery etc

makemeahanzi.definition: bracelet, ring; to surround, to loop

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (a variant of 玉, jade) — 环 originally referred to a round jade ring or bracelet
不 (bù) gives a sound distantly related to 环's reading huán, having drifted apart considerably over time
车 (cart) — 软 originally described a cart with cushioned, springy wheels, giving a soft ride.
欠 (qiàn) gives a sound distantly related to ruǎn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to butt, to gore, to ram; to touch

characterDeckComponents.note: 角 (horn) — 触 originally described an animal butting or goring with its horns, extended to any physical contact.
虫 (chóng) gives a sound distantly related to chù, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A mouse, with two paws to the left and the tail to the right

characterDeckComponents.note: 鼠 pictures a mouse in profile, with paws on one side and a long tail trailing on the other, giving the character its meaning 'mouse, rat.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to display, to exhibit; to plead; surname

etymology.hint: To place 阝 facing east 东

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/place) — represents a location or settlement.
东 (east) — a settlement facing east gave 陈 meanings like 'to arrange, display,' and it became a common Chinese surname.
钅 (metal) — 银 refers to silver, a metal
艮 (gèn) gives a sound distantly related to 银's reading yín, having drifted apart over time
禾 (grain) — a heavy, ripe stalk of grain standing steady in the field ties to 稳's meaning 'stable, steady.'
㥯 (wěn) gives the sound — an exact match with 稳's reading wěn.

etymology.hint: A person bent over 尸 with a towel 巾

characterDeckComponents.note: A person's bent-over body shape.
A cloth or towel, used for cleaning.

etymology.hint: A tiger 虍 standing on a rock 几; 虍 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 虍 pictures a tiger's head and stripes.
几 below pictures its legs and tail, together giving a full picture of a tiger.

meanings: see 可汗[ke4 han2], 汗國|汗国[han2 guo2]

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 汗 names sweat, a bodily fluid.
干 (gān) shares the rhyme -an with hàn, though the initial has drifted from g- to h- over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to excuse, to forgive, to show mercy

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恕 describes a heartfelt willingness to forgive.
如 (rú) gives a sound only distantly related to shù today, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Wine 酉 aged too long 夋; 夋 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 酉 depicts a wine jar — 酸 relates to fermented drink.
夋 here marks the wine as aged for a long time — wine left too long turns sour, giving 酸 its meaning 'sour, acidic.'

meanings: to support oneself by holding onto something

makemeahanzi.definition: to support, to protect, to help

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows 扶 relates to physically supporting something with the hand.
夫 (fū) gives a sound close to fú, differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rush in, to charge in, to burst in

etymology.hint: A horse 马 charging through a gate 门

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (gate, door) marks a boundary being crossed.
马 (horse) rushes through the gate — a horse charging in, giving 闯 its meaning 'to rush in, to dash.'

meanings: large room for a specific purpose

makemeahanzi.definition: hall, large room; government office; cousins

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 堂 names a hall, a large room built on the ground.
尚 (shàng) gives a rhyme close to táng, with the initial shifted.
犭 (dog) reflects an old association with fierce animals, extended to describe cruelty in 狠.
艮 (gèn) gives a sound distantly related to hěn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to turn, to twist, to wrench; to grasp, to seize

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — twisting is done with the hand.
Gives the sound chǒu, related to niǔ but drifted apart over time.
